item.title: These Villagers Wonder if They’re on the Front Line of Russia’s Shadow War
item.description: Russia is accused of clandestine attacks on Ukraine’s allies in Europe, most notably at Leipzig/Halle airport in eastern Germany. That has changed life for villagers nearby.

item.title: Rio Tinto to Pay $250 Million to Address Mine’s Environmental Damage
item.description: The landmark deal will also go toward remedying human rights problems caused by the long-closed Papua New Guinea mine.

item.title: What to Know About the Myanmar Genocide Case at the World Court
item.description: The International Court of Justice is issuing a landmark verdict on whether the state of Myanmar committed genocide.

item.title: Boris Grebenshchikov, a Russian Rock Musician With a ‘Need to Rebel’
item.description: In the 1980s, Boris Grebenshchikov led a revered Russian underground band. A rereleased documentary from that era is bringing new attention to his work.

item.title: Villa Where Trump, Xi and Putin Will Meet Once Hosted Kim Jong-il
item.description: The secluded Kylin Villa resort in the Chinese city of Shenzhen once hosted the North Korean dictator, Xi Jinping’s father and envoys of the Dalai Lama.
